label: Parte 4
subtitle: Tema abstracto · discurso de 2 minutos
objetivo: Hablar 2 minutos completos sin quedarte en blanco. Variedad gramatical (presente, pasado, futuro, condicional). Usar idioms B2/C1. Aquí es donde más nota subes.

pasos.title: Introducción · romper el hielo
pasos.template: It's widely recognised that [tema] has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world.
pasos.trick: 'It's widely recognised that...' es pasiva impersonal B2/C1. Suena académico, sube nivel cualitativo al instante.

pasos.title: Opinión + razonamiento
pasos.grammar: Presente simple + futuro + linkers de adición
pasos.template: There's no denying that [tema] has transformed the way we [verbo]. One of the main advantages is that it helps us [verbo + complemento]. What's more, more and more people are [verbo + -ing] these days.

opciones: stay connected with our loved ones

pasos.trick: 'helps us SAVE' (sin 'to'). 'More and more' es comparativo progresivo B2 puro.

pasos.title: Contraargumento
pasos.template: However, [tema] also has some drawbacks, such as [problema 1] or [problema 2]. Although it's generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that [matiz negativo].

opciones: not everyone has equal access to it
its long-term effects are still unclear
it requires a lot of self-discipline

pasos.trick: 'Overlook' > 'forget'. 'We shouldn't overlook the fact that...' es estructura B2 pura.
pasos.warning: Tras 'such as' solo sustantivos o gerundios, NUNCA infinitivos.

pasos.title: Experiencia personal · storytelling
pasos.grammar: Pasado simple + pasado continuo · VARIEDAD GRAMATICAL clave
pasos.template: This reminds me of the time when I [pasado simple]. I remember once [pasado continuo + detalle], and I learnt that [lección].

opciones: decided to disconnect from social media for a week
looked after my little nephew for a whole weekend
had a really demanding project at work
I was scrolling through Instagram late at night and realised I'd wasted three hours
I was working overtime and felt completely drained
I was walking around a small town and felt completely amazed
I was preparing dinner for the whole family and felt really fulfilled
stepping out of your comfort zone really opens your mind

pasos.trick: Mezclar pasado simple y pasado continuo en la misma frase = demostración instantánea de control gramatical B2.

pasos.title: Hipótesis y futuro
pasos.template: If I were in this situation, I would probably [acción condicional]. In the future, I think people will [acción futura], especially due to [causa].

opciones: look for a better work-life balance
become more aware of its impact

pasos.trick: Usa 'were' con todos los sujetos en condicional 2 ('If I WERE'). Más B2 que 'was'.
pasos.warning: 'If I am in this situation, I will...' → ERROR. Hipótesis = condicional 2: 'If I were... I would...'.

pasos.title: Cierre con idiom B2/C1
pasos.template: In a nutshell, [tema] is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance. All things considered, it's here to stay, and we just need to learn how to use it wisely.
pasos.trick: Tres idioms en una frase: 'in a nutshell' + 'double-edged sword' + 'here to stay'. Memorízalos como bloques.

temas.label: Stress
preguntas: Tell me about a time when you were stressed out.
What made you feel that way?
Why do people get stressed in modern life?
temas.respuesta_modelo: It's widely recognised that stress has become increasingly relevant in modern society. From my point of view, these kinds of situations are very common nowadays, especially in our fast-paced world. There's no denying that stress has transformed the way we live. One of the main advantages of dealing with stress properly is that it helps us reduce our stress levels in the long run. What's more, more and more people are looking for healthier habits these days. However, stress also has some drawbacks, such as burnout or social isolation. Although a bit of pressure is generally beneficial, we shouldn't overlook the fact that its long-term effects on mental health are still unclear. This reminds me of the time when I had a really demanding project at work. I remember once I was working overtime and felt completely drained, and I learnt that setting limits really matters. If I were in this situation again, I would probably set clearer boundaries. In the future, I think people will look for a better work-life balance, especially due to growing awareness. In a nutshell, stress is a double-edged sword: we just need to find the right balance.
